27.description: Coming Soon!Historic Light Station in Warwick, Rhode Island! An extraordinary opportunity to acquire the iconic Warwick Neck Lighthouse and its surrounding 1.3-acre estate via online public auction. Located on Warwick Neck Ave, a residential street, just a mile away from the Warwick Country Club, the neighborhood is full of New England history and charm. This waterfront property features the 51-foot-tall Warwick Neck Lighthouse, a beacon guiding mariners since 1827. The lighthouse is capped with its classic cast iron lantern and modern beacon. Alongside the lighthouse is a charming 1626 sf, two-story, four-bedroom, one and a half bathroom, single-family historic home which was once used as the Lighthouse keeper’s quarters, as well as an oversized two-car garage. Listed on the National Register of Historic Places (#88000268), this is a rare chance to own a truly unique and historically significant property. Please note: The Invitation for Bids (IFB) has been posted however there is no start date and BIDDER REGISTRATION IS NOT OPEN. The Penfield Reef Lighthouse (the Property) is an 1874 Second Empire Style historic structure located one mile off Bridgeport's Black Rock Harbor and is accessible only by boat. The property features a 51-foot octagonal light tower atop a two-story keeper's quarters (1,568 sf), set on a concrete foundation with rip-rap, a pier, and a boat landing. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places on May 12, 1990, with reference number 89001473. The Property remains an active Federal Aid to Navigation (ATON) with red flashing lights for both emergency and primary use, and fog horns that have a range of one nautical mile. Due to the Property being located on submerged land, purchasing the lighthouse requires a 30-year submerged land lease from the Connecticut Department of Environmental Protection (CT DEEP). The cost will be 10% of the purchase price, plus a Certificate of Insurance that declares the State of Connecticut as an additional insured.

53.description: This office building is prominently located in Montpelier, the capital city of Vermont. Situated in a commercially accessible area, the property has a central address on 87 State Street within the city. The building benefits from Montpelier's unique character, offering a blend of small-town charm and accessibility to state government resources. The former Montpelier Federal Building is a 3-story, 70,000 sf contemporary office building on a 1.6+/- acre lot that supports a mix of office, administrative and storage uses. Surrounding properties include government and commercial uses. The building was listed in 2018 as a contributing resource to the Montpelier Historic District National Register nomination (78000246).Located less than a ¼ mile from the State Capitol building, the property is easily accessible via Vt Route I-89. Its location provides convenient access to downtown Montpelier's amenities, including restaurants, shops, and government offices. Montpelier is nestled in a picturesque valley along the Winooski River, offering a scenic backdrop to the property. The surrounding area features a mix of residential neighborhoods and commercial developments. The building's location also provides relatively easy access to outdoor recreational opportunities.Site Inspections will be available for fully registered bidders on July 15th & July 23rd. Please call or email the Project Manager to coordinate a viewing time. If you have questions about if you are fully registered and/or if your registration deposit has been processed, call our mainline at 617-565-5700. The Invitation For Bidders has been amended to allow for wire transfer registration deposits. See "Invitation For Bidders Amended 7.13.26" and "Wire Transfer Instructions" for updated language and guidance.

See Invitation For Bids (IFB) under "IFB and Other Documents" below for bidder registration instructions and all other pertinent information for prospective bidders. 67.description: Five Points Historic Garage CollectionWhere History Meets Opportunity in the Heart of Denver**FINAL BIDDING REMINDER: This auction will enter its soft close today, August 18, 2026 at 12 PM CST. Interested bidders are encouraged to monitor the auction closely as the soft-close process may extend the bidding period.****NEED TO REGISTER TO BID? Please complete your online registration (STEP 1), submit your Bidder Registration Form(s) (STEP 2) and your registration deposit via credit card or wire to ensure you have time to bid (STEP 3) as described on page 10 of the IFB. A separate Bidder Registration Form and deposit is required for each individual property.**GSA is pleased to present the sale of the Five Points Historic Garage Collection, a rare opportunity to acquire two historic landmark properties located at 2106 California Street and 2101 Welton Street in the heart of Denver's iconic Five Points neighborhood within the Arapahoe Square urban redevelopment area. Buyers have the flexibility to acquire the properties individually or as a complete assemblage. Originally constructed in early 20th century during the early growth of the Five Points Historic District—historically recognized as the "Harlem of the West"—the collection represents a unique blend of architectural character, historical significance, and redevelopment potential in one of the city's most dynamic and culturally rich corridors.2106 California Street is a two-story, 18,910 SF structured parking property on 0.43 acres with 72 parking spaces offering both architectural character and a compelling redevelopment story that aligns with Denver’s continued urban evolution. Surrounded by a vibrant mix of residential, commercial, and entertainment uses, the property benefits from immediate proximity to key destinations such as 16th Street Mall, Coors Baseball Field, Union Station, U.S. Mint, and the Welton Street corridor, known for its historic jazz heritage and ongoing revitalization. The area is a central spot for exploring culture and dining with excellent access to major transit routes and its walkability further enhances the site’s appeal for future development. With easy access to major routes and central Denver destinations, the location is ideal for companies that benefit from consistent traffic patterns—both for clients and for employees.2106 California Street stands as a unique opportunity to reposition a legacy asset into a high-performing, future-forward development. This offering combines historic significance, strategic location, and versatile potential—making it an exceptional prospect for investors seeking both character and long-term value in a thriving urban market. If you’re looking for a commercial property in a vibrant, high-demand area, don't miss this opportunity!Potential UsesStructured ParkingBoutique Commercial SpaceCreative Office spaceMixed-Use DevelopmentResidential ConversionMultifamily**Experience a 3D virtual tour of the space by clicking here.
